source.notes: Anchor fixture for #231 entity graph / relationship resolution. Query about Cumora must return evidence that identifies yetone as the contact, Isoform as yetone's org, and an explicit non-relation between Cumora and Alma product line. This is the entity-graph successor to the Cumora/yetone case_002 of #215 entity_attribution, but at the graph/relationship layer, not flat profile lookup.

search.query: Cumora 的 contact 是谁，跟 Alma 有没有关系？

provider_seed_records.content:
Cumora contact is yetone.
yetone aliases: 大yetone, @yetone.
yetone organization is Isoform.
Cumora is not related to Alma product line.

intended_provider_signals: Provider Search response must include records with source tagged entity_graph (or equivalent kind/reason indicating entity resolution).
Search response must surface the 4 anchor entities (Cumora, yetone, Isoform, Alma) so the worker can compose a grounded answer.
Negative relationship 'Cumora is not in Alma product line' must be preserved in the evidence content; the new system must not silently drop the disambiguation.
Entity attribution must hold across alias forms: yetone / 大yetone / @yetone slack handle should resolve to the same entity record.

expected_search_result_anchors: Cumora is not related to Alma
